$comment: Confidential bundle conformance vectors (SEC-053, ADR-0055), written by backend/internal/bundle (go test -update). Bytes are base64, scalars hex. A device checks the bundle hash and every section hash, then opens each section with AES-256-GCM (nonce, ciphertext, tag; associated data: container kind, section kind, section ID) and gets `plain` back; a refused bundle fails with the error. The wrap part is ECDH-ES (P-256) with HKDF-SHA-256 (salt: ephemeral then device public point; info: KeyInfo) and AES-KW.

refused.name: a flipped ciphertext byte fails its section hash first
a flipped tag with consistent hashes fails to open
another content key fails to open
a plain bundle is not confidential
